title: Isn't CBA Ultimate Awards a Better Credit Card for Travel than Bendigo Ready?
body:
We have an overseas trip coming up, so I'm looking at credit cards with no international transaction fee to maximize our spending. Our daily driver is a Bendigo Ready which is decent on its own - no annual fee, no international transaction fee, complimentary insurance. However, it doesn't offer reward points or other travelling perks.
However I was looking at the offering in Debit & Credit Cards with No International Fees and found the CBA Ultimate Awards credit card which offers:
No monthly fee if spending $4000 or more
Earn CommBank Awards (3x points for international spending) which can be transferred to Velocity at 1:0.5 rate . Qantas rewards program requires extra fee.
Complimentary travel insurance
Complimentary 2x lounge passes
Cashback offers from CommBank Yello program (this requires a CBA transaction account)
In summary, this is better than Bendigo Ready card if you are spending $4k/month or more, however I rarely see it mentioned in the discussion. If anyone is using CBA Ultimate Awards, can you share your experience?
